title: Investigate why reviewer tasks #782 and #785 never started
what: Iteration 0177 ordered #782 and iteration 0178 ordered #785 (both role reviewer, model default, effort low, limits 30 min / 15 turns). Record 0177 shows 0 turns, no status, no branch. Record 0178 has no session entry for #785 in outcome.sessions. The shaper sessions of both iterations finished and merged.
why: Two orders in a row did not start, and the cause is on the engine side, not in the task text. The orchestrator will not order the same check a third time. It records the unexecuted mutation check of review #779 as a documented limit. If the start failure is tied to the reviewer role or to its routing (codex first), later review chains will stall the same way.
unblocks: Reliable independent reviewer sessions for later changed-scope reviews.
